subject: A small kneeling soldier in a steel-grey chainmail hauberk with a mail coif and a sleeveless tan cloth tabard over it, brown leather boots, crouching low and raising one forearm over his face as a sheet of orange and yellow flame sweeps down at him from the upper left and parts around him.

A burst of crackling electricity: dozens of thin pale-cyan and white sparks and tiny forked lightning lines shooting out in every direction from one blazing white point at the centre, scattered with small four-pointed glints.

Head-and-shoulders bust of a calm middle-aged man wearing a steel-grey chainmail coif that covers his head and neck, eyes closed in meditation, a small brilliant white star of light shining from a jewel on his forehead.
